rows.name: Arnold Koller
rows.note: The executive is the seven-member Federal Council; the presidency rotates annually and Koller's year began on the start date itself. Federal Councillor since 1 Jan 1987 (elected 10 Dec 1986). must_leave_by is the hard end of the one-year presidency.

rows.note: Party pillar = the thirty-three hereditary nobles, the court estate through which the House of Tupou governs; the king appointed the PM (his brother) and the cabinet. No party table exists.

rows.name: A. N. R. Robinson
rows.note: Parliamentary system: the prime minister directs the executive. Robinson led the NAR government of December 1986.
